paper_title: The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2
caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa
model_annotation: This chart displays the distribution of different content types within the Darija Open Dataset (DODa). The chart contains six slices, representing categories such as “Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy),” “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives),” “Translated Sentences,” “Extra + Augmented Data,” “Pending Translations,” and “Translated Extra.” The largest slice, colored orange and labeled “Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy),” appears to represent approximately 43,000 units, while the second largest slice, colored blue and labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives),” represents approximately 45,387 units. The third largest slice, colored green and labeled “Translated Extra,” is approximately 30,000 units in size.  The smallest slices are colored yellow and labeled “Translated Sentences” (approximately 23,108 units) and teal and labeled “Pending Translations” (approximately 45,387 units), respectively.  No legend or percentage labels are evident within the slices, and the segments appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of area.
